en.title: Distinct Strings from Reversing One Substring
en.description:
Choose any non-empty contiguous substring and reverse it once. Find how many distinct strings can be obtained. Reversing a substring of length 1 is allowed, so the original string is included.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string of length 1..100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: The answer is 1 plus the number of index pairs whose two characters differ. Scan each character and accumulate the length so far minus the count of the same character so far.
